title: skills: teach `lifecycle.seal` (audit hash-chain sealing) in objectstack-data lifecycle rules
body:
domain:server#4 · os-support-ai · session_01WGufzi1tLRTEYwYGtbNCyk

Skills-docs follow-up owed by PR #32348 (card #31908, slice P1b-2). That PR's body reads `Metadata-protocol: added`: `lifecycle.seal` joins the ADR-0057 lifecycle block. Its `Skills-docs:` line names the file below. A `domain:server` PR does not edit `skills/**`, so the teaching is owed here.

**File:** `skills/objectstack-data/rules/lifecycle.md`. Today it teaches the lifecycle classes, `retention`, `ttl` and `archive`, and says nothing of `seal`.

**What to teach** (read the published spec once #32348 merges; `packages/spec/src/data/object.zod.ts`, the `seal` key and its refinements, is the authority):
- `lifecycle.seal` opts an `audit`-class object into hash-chain sealing. Each closed window's rows are folded into a signed checkpoint per chain, and per-row value fields feed the leaf hash.
- The authoring refusals an AI is likely to trip:
  - `ttl.onlyWhen` beside `seal`;
  - `valueFields` naming `id` or `created_at` (they already order the leaves);
  - `valueFields` naming an undeclared field.
- The run-time requirement: the object needs its own `tenant_id` field, or the sealer reports the plan as an error.
- The honest limit until expiry ships (P4 of #31908): the sweeper still deletes sealed rows, which later read as missing.
- One ✅ and one ❌ example in the page's `os:check` style, and the matching eval case(s) the skill's evals harness takes.

**Serial:** after #32348 merges. Later slices of #31908 (P2–P4) may extend `seal`; teach what is on main when this card is picked up.

**Lane:** `domain:skills` (`skills/**`).
